description: This file contains unit tests for the Nix Mode feature in an application, specifically testing the resolution of Nix Mode settings from a stable suite in different application bundle contexts.

classes.name: NixModeStableSuiteTests
classes.description: A test suite struct decorated with annotations to run as a testing suite, containing two test methods.

methods.name: resolves from stable suite for app bundles
methods.description: Tests whether the Nix mode resolves correctly from a stable user defaults suite when running in an app bundle.

methods.name: ignores stable suite outside app bundles
methods.description: Tests that the stable suite is ignored for Nix mode resolution when not running as an app bundle.
